g.text: USB: J2's VBUS on PC9 (JP7): keep the D+ pull-up off (SDIS) while PC9 is low.

g.text: BOOT0: hold B3, press B2 (DFU). RDP Level 2 locks out SWD and DFU for good.

g.desc: BOOT0: hold B3, press B2 (DFU). RDP Level 2 locks out SWD and DFU for good.

g.text: IDD: cut JP1, ammeter across J4. JP8/JP9 cut: D0/D1 free of the COM port.

g.desc: IDD: cut JP1, ammeter across J4. JP8/JP9 cut: D0/D1 free of the COM port.
